artist.name: vaultboy
artist.short_description: vaultboy is an Afterglow discovery artist in the broader emotional-pop and songwriter catalogue.
artist.biography: vaultboy is the recording name of American pop singer-songwriter Jeremiah Daly. A native of Jacksonville, Florida, he built an audience by posting short songwriting ideas online before releasing 'everything sucks' in 2021. The song came from a request to write something happy and a deliberately sarcastic opening idea; he later finished it after listeners responded to the snippet. The early viral moment was followed by songs such as 'rocket science,' 'aftermath' and 'i wish u knew,' plus the vaultboy EP. He later released everything and nothing and the 2026 album ARE YOU EVER COMING BACK?. In interviews he has described wanting to make music that listeners experience as nostalgic and has noted how a joke can coexist with an emotional undercurrent. This ability to move between upbeat presentation and vulnerable subject matter makes him a useful male-voice addition to Afterglow's discovery catalogue. Editorial descriptions should avoid making the story of 'everything sucks' stand in for the meaning of every subsequent song; interview-based themes must remain attached to the relevant recording.
